Dream 2026-11-22 suggests a refinement: broaden.

**What the vignettes add.** The domain lists the dream cycle but the vignettes define its role: vignettes are short-term memory, the dream cycle "uses these moments to build a stable, up to date, model of reality" and affirmation freezes it (3d26c906); it "is part of the process of working with long and short term memory" (c8b12a7b); the process keeps being refined with blurry edges (411ad3bf); recording is selective, "semantically relevant. Not just commands" (2dae3dd1); work is recorded somewhere safe to inform refinements (3e99c52f); the dream manages the list, keeping hierarchy navigable (17cc3c02); it keeps testing data in different scenarios (38ad151f); recurring storylines across vignettes make stronger dreams (b2caaca7); early conversations were not available to agents (a0e650ea, 2026-11-06), so memory depth is limited by what was captured.

**Proposed.** What happened is reported, measured and ratified, and the practice changes because of it. Vignettes are short-term memory of specific moments; the dream cycle consolidates them into a stable, current model of domains, problems and personas, stronger where the same storyline recurs; affirmation freezes it. Run reports, sessions, retrospectives, indicators, the handbook, srs-context, CLAUDE.md files.

**Depth.** Moderate: 10 vignettes, 2026-10-30 to 2026-11-22; recurring, process still being refined by the owner's own account.

If you agree, the change is made by succession: a successor that supersedes this record, which stays as it is.
